apps.name: Daraja Compass
apps.next: Nothing waiting on you. The country-card problem is fully fixed and on main. All three videos now set the place on their very first line, so the “Where are you?” card never covers the narration — checked on 8 Nov by this chat on main, not taken on trust: played the 2-minute overview in shop/watch.html with no key in storage and watched the iframe, and the card appears in none of 16 samples across 80 seconds, where before the fix it was on screen at 5, 10, 15 and 20 seconds. node shop/checkvideos.js compass also passes all three. THE RECORDINGS DID NOT GO STALE: all 16 lines that changed kept their spoken text exactly — they only gained the js that sets the place — so no voice fell back to the browser one. Compared line by line between 6add603 and e791d73: nothing added, nothing removed. HOW TO RUN THE CHECKER, because this chat got it wrong first time and wrote the wrong thing here: node shop/checkvideos.js DOES run in a cloud container. It serves the jerrywins1.github.io URLs out of the working copy itself, but it needs a static server on port 8731 at the repository root first — python3 -m http.server 8731 — and says so in its own header. Without it you get 0 of 3 and it looks like a network block. Do NOT override BASE in shop/apps_data.js to work around that; that is a live file and it would be a real bug. A LIMITATION OF THE CHECKER, ALREADY KNOWN AND WRITTEN INTO THAT FILE, AND THE STORE MANAGER'S TO FIX, NOT THIS CHAT'S: on a line with no js and no pointer it tests only for a password box and a blank page, so a country card passes. It is why this fault went unseen, and the same gap let the HQ videos pass while showing their password gate. Related datum if anyone picks it up: its screen-change counter reports “1 screens” for all three Compass videos even though the screens demonstrably do change, so that signal is not currently measuring what it means to. STILL OPEN, WHENEVER THE APP IS NEXT TOUCHED, NEITHER URGENT: the videos pick Kenya for every viewer, which wants revisiting if Compass gets a real US audience; and render() bailing out on needPlace() is a wall for anything driving the app from outside — a tour, a test script, a video — so curing it there rather than line by line would stop this coming back.

apps.next: Test script written 8 Nov: testers/scripts/ingoodorder.json, 16 steps, 30 minutes. Jerry made the artifact link public that night so testers can open it without a Claude account. The script opens with the rule Jerry's review asked for, in the intro where they read it before step 1: MADE-UP DETAILS ONLY, no real bank account, PIN, password or M-Pesa. Reason given in the script itself - asking someone to type real bank details into an app they have just met is the shape of a scam, and Daraja Academy teaches older people to refuse exactly that. It also warns that there is no passphrase reset, and that the printed binder shows PINs in plain text. STILL TO DO, AND IT IS NOT THIS CHAT'S TO DO: the app has to appear in the store catalogue (APPS and TEST_NOW in shop/apps_data.js) before it shows on the Testers' List, and the catalogue belongs to the Store Manager chat.
